notes.title: Summer Tournaments Announced!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Get ready to take flight, pilots![/b][/h2][h3]We're excited to announce the WarBirds 2025 Summer Tournament Series, where veteran aces and fresh recruits alike can test their skill in intense historical air battles all season long![/h3][h3][/h3][p]Winners receive:[/p][list][*][p]1st Place: 2 months subscription to WarBirds2025[/p][/*][*][p]2nd Place: 1 month subscription to WarBirds2025[/p][/*][*][p]3rd Place:  ½ month subscription to WarBirds2025[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]✈️ D-Day Breakout[/h3][p]Dates: Sunday, June 8 & Sunday, June 22
Time: Starting at 2030HRS EST
Take part in this two-part event as we reenact the breakout from Normandy in epic fashion.[/p][p][/p][h3]🌊 Battle of the Coral Sea[/h3][p]Dates: Saturday, July 13 & Saturday, July 27[/p][p]Time: Starting at 2030HRS EST
Fly in the Pacific Theatre as carrier-based fighters clash over the open ocean. Bring your best![/p][p][/p][h3]🔥 August Campaign Battles[/h3][p]Dates: Sunday, August 10 & Sunday, August 24[/p][p]Time: Starting at 2030HRS EST
Two intense frames of WWII combat featuring surprise mission parameters and all-out warfare.[/p][p][/p][h3]🏁 Valley Combat Target Race[/h3][p]Date: Sunday, September 7[/p][p]Time: Starting at 2030HRS EST
Race through a treacherous valley in this fast-paced, low-altitude combat challenge. Precision flying and sharp shooting required![/p][p]
[/p][p]Mark your calendars, squad up, and get your aircraft ready.
 Stay tuned for exact start times and mission briefings in the official WarBirds Discord and forums.[/p][p]Let the skies burn and the legends rise. See you out there, pilots! [/p][p]
[/p]
